{{Quote|This hash is made with a generous amount of bantha beef, Ojomian onions and protatoes.|Dex's Diner menu, on the "Besalisk's Bellyful" hash|<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />}}
'''Ojomian onions''' were a type of [[Onion/Legends|onion]]<ref name="Dining at Dex's" /> that shared its name with the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ojom/Legends|Ojom]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Ultimate Alien Anthology">''[[Ultimate Alien Anthology]]''</ref> The onion was used as an ingredient in a number of the dishes available at [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]], an [[Restaurant/Legends|eatery]] operated by the Besalisk [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] planet [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The dishes included [[apple slug stew]], [[nyork chowder]], [[shaak pot roast]], [["Besalisk's Bellyful" hash]], and [[gartro egg omelet]]. They were also served grilled on the diner's fried [[Nerf steak/Legends|nerfsteak]] and its [[Coruscant slider]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />

==Behind the scenes==
Ojomian onions were mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," an article written by [[Gregory Walker]] as an [[in-universe]] menu for Dex's Diner that was published on the [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]] section of [[StarWars.com]] on [[December 3]], [[2009]].<ref name="Dining at Dex's" />
